search_budget: One final family. Stop this edge-search branch after the frozen development/validation verdict; do not create another family from the result.
prior_evidence_disclosure: Form4 cluster5 metadata was already observed to have small positive aggregate PnL but failed temporal gates. This transaction-level family is a diagnostic refinement, not pristine hypothesis discovery.
hypothesis: Open-market purchase/sale semantics can separate informative Form 4 clusters from grants, exercises, and routine filing noise after a confirmed opening response.

samples.oos: 2025-2026 prohibited for this final family regardless of result; globally touched data and search budget ends at validation

fetch_contract.source: Official SEC quarterly Insider Transactions Data Sets flattened from ownershipDocument XML as filed; exact SEC Archives XML is an accession-level audit/fallback source.
fetch_contract.eligible_fetch_set: All exact Form 4 accessions in the cached PIT top500 issuer-CIK union accepted after the 2017-12-29 prior-session cutoff through 2024, joined to the official SEC bulk issuer CIK. Assign to the full PIT trading calendar first; then require issuer cluster3 and apply the frozen top500/market gate.
fetch_contract.fair_access: Declared User-Agent and resumable local cache. Prefer 29 quarterly ZIP requests (2017Q4 and 2018Q1-2024Q4); archive fallback is no more than 8 requests/second with no refetch of valid cached XML.
fetch_contract.implementation_amendment_before_performa: SEC Archives returned HTTP 429 after 2,814 cached XML files. Before any transaction-level PnL replay, source transport was switched to the SEC official quarterly flattened ownership-XML data. Exact accession joins and every hypothesis, sample, transaction semantic, candidate, cost, and gate remain unchanged.
fetch_contract.issuer_identity_audit_before_performance: Exact bulk joins found 16 of 5,832 accessions where the submissions-cache entity CIK was a reporting owner rather than the XML issuer. Their transaction values are zeroed; any nominal cluster left with fewer than three issuer-matched Form 4 accessions is excluded. Candidate rules and performance remain unseen.
fetch_contract.session_calendar_correction_after_invali: The first replay exposed that the inherited section-6.207 signal file assigned SEC events using feature-cache dates, whose first intraday date is 2018-04-27, collapsing earlier 2018 filings into that date. Those artifacts are invalid and cannot support a verdict. The correction rebuilds all clusters from the full PIT filter calendar beginning 2018-01-02 and the official bulk issuer CIK. No candidate, threshold, hold, direction, cost, or gate changed after viewing the invalid replay.

transaction_contract.purchase: transactionCode P with acquired/disposed code A
transaction_contract.sale: transactionCode S with acquired/disposed code D
transaction_contract.dollar_notional: transactionShares * transactionPricePerShare when both are finite and positive
transaction_contract.missing_price: Transaction remains counted by code but contributes zero to dollar totals and is reported in coverage QA.
transaction_contract.ownership: Direct and indirect holdings are both included; no beneficial-owner identity selection.
transaction_contract.excluded: Derivative transactions and all non-P/S codes, including grants and exercises, do not enter P/S dollar totals.
transaction_contract.aggregation: Sum P and S transactions across every exact Form 4 accession in the issuer-session cluster.

market_contract.event: At least three exact Form 4 filings for issuer CIK assigned to the same PIT session.
market_contract.availability: First trading session whose 09:15 ET cutoff is strictly after each SEC acceptance timestamp.
market_contract.universe: Quarterly PIT market-cap top500 representative per CIK plus current price>=5 and lagged ADV20>=10m.
market_contract.reaction: Absolute gap>=1%, rvol930>=1.25, absolute first5>=0.20%, gap and first5 same sign.
market_contract.exit: Exact 15:55 on the hold-th session, entry session counted as day 1.

portfolio_contract.overlap: No new position while issuer CIK is active.
portfolio_contract.capacity: Entry notional <=1% of current PIT ADV20.
portfolio_contract.missing_entry: Skip without replacement unless exact 09:35 exists.
portfolio_contract.missing_exit: Retain until next exact 09:35 or 15:55, whichever occurs first.

selection_rule.ranking: Highest base-4bps Sharpe among candidates passing every development gate.
selection_rule.tie_break: Higher stress8 Sharpe, then larger entry count, then shorter hold.
selection_rule.terminal_policy: Report continue/kill/needs audit, but do not open 2025-2026 and do not derive another candidate family.

audit_requirements: Report XML fetch/parse failures, P/S code counts, missing-price coverage, candidate counts, both costs, yearly PnL, dollar and percentage DD, concentration, turnover, borrow, exposure, and long/short entries.
Rebuild session clusters, portfolio, overlap, costs, and compounding causally; no PnL subtraction or refill shortcut.
Do not infer insider intent beyond exact Form 4 transaction codes.
Do not use old manual/restricted 62 or 2025-2026 price data.
